non_head_order_exists.meaning: a price level contains a non-head order in its doubly linked list

new_order_appended.meaning: a new order is appended to a price level's list, requiring both forward and back links to be updated

order_reachable_via_chain.meaning: the earlier order remains addressable via the limit's headOrder/tailOrder chain (visible to traversal, matching and user cancels)

counters_reflect_reachable_only.meaning: numBids/Asks and open-interest counters count only reachable orders

assumptions: The corruption persists because every operation is wrapped in a successful transaction (as_corruption_persists).
The append and removal occur within Book._updateLimitPostOrder on the same price level.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of open-interest inflation/deflation; counters_reflect_reachable_only is a qualitative Boolean whose numeric binding is deferred to code binding.

limitations: Formalizes only i_orphaned_orders; corrupted price levels, sentinel freeze and open-interest misstatement are separate impacts handled in other passes.
Reachability and counter correspondence are represented as grounded Booleans because the report states the observable conditions without numeric definitions.
